## SCUM Tactical Map & Chat Translator v2.4.3

### Fixed
- All confirmation and notice boxes (delete a player, clear history, delete a profile, hotkey conflict, update check, import of waypoints) now use one tidy dialog: icon on the left, text beside it, translated Yes/No buttons on the right. They used to show text pushed to one side and English "Yes / No".
- The safe answer ("No") is the default button; dangerous confirmations use a red "Yes".

### Update
Installed users: tray icon → "Check for updates". Others: download `SCUM_Chat_Translator.exe` or `SCUM_Chat_Translator_Portable.exe`. Settings, points and players are kept.
